after_ref: the change that adds this entry
composition: Each row: the same studio render of before_ref and of this change, cropped alike to the model (or to `crop`, in source pixels, widened to 16:9) and resized to 800x450, before left, after right, short labels. JPEG quality 80. Both columns rendered in one roster pass each from checkouts of before_ref and of this change. The rebels' pickups lost their sandbags, and crews their camouflage nets, before merge: the technical's row was rendered again from both refs with the sandbags taken off.
